That is relevant to launch readiness, even if it is not enough by itself to eliminate all caveats.

On the model-card point, the current draft wording is the weakest part of the packet, not the entire certification position. `ISTRESS-DRAFT-MITIGATION-029-HF-CONTENT` supports including intended uses, limitations, and evaluation results, and `ISTRESS-DRAFT-MITIGATION-029-CONTEXT` shows the disclosure issue was already recognized in review. The narrower argument is that the same record supports certification only on a caveated basis, because policy distinguishes readiness from disclosure and approved mitigation predicates.
5. The auditor's current writeup already reaches most of that conclusion.
